def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid); w = len(grid[0])
    pats = [
        [[9 if c % 2 == 0 else 8 for c in range(w)] for _ in range(h)],
        [[8 if c % 2 == 0 else 9 for c in range(w)] for _ in range(h)],
        [[9 if r % 2 == 0 else 8 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)],
        [[8 if r % 2 == 0 else 9 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)],
    ]
    scores = [sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if p[r][c] == grid[r][c]) for p in pats]
    best = max(scores)
    for i in [2, 3, 0, 1]:
        if scores[i] == best:
            return pats[i]
    return pats[2]
